name: WPA Free Card Acquisition, Learning and Partnership Growth Model
core_formula: OPEN_AUTHORITY -> WPA_FREE_CARD -> GUIDED_OPEN_KNOWLEDGE -> ENGAGEMENT -> PREMIUM_LEARNING -> CONTRIBUTION -> PARTNERSHIP -> INSTITUTIONAL_MONETIZATION
principle: WPA first demonstrates value through open, attributable knowledge. Membership then adds identity, guidance, learning structure and community. Premium value, contribution status, partnerships and monetization are earned or activated later through separate governed paths.

free_card.purpose: acquisition, belonging, orientation and guided entry into the WPA knowledge and learning ecosystem
free_card.launch_rule: Do not represent a visual card, QR or public ID as active membership until an authorised registry record exists.
free_card.open_knowledge_rule: Public/open Zenodo records and other open WPA publications remain readable without membership. WPA Free Card must never be presented as the legal or technical key to content that is already publicly open.
member_value_after_registry_activation: WPA Free member identity backed by an authorised registry record
guided WPA Open Knowledge Library entry
thematic reading paths across Protocol, Diplomacy, Public Communication, Security Studies, Communicology and AI Governance
saved-reading and progress layer when account infrastructure is activated
new-publication and briefing notifications when communication consent is available
selected free briefings, webinars and orientation resources
clear upgrade route to WPA Pro, Academic Pro and Institutional offerings

sources.label: WPA Scientific Papers
sources.role: public WPA research and publication surface

sources.label: WPA Zenodo Community
sources.role: external authoritative repository surface for open WPA records

open_knowledge_library.member_upgrade_value: Membership may add curation, guided sequences, progress, recommendations and learning identity; it does not privatise already-public source records.

contribution_and_merit.name: Professional Observer
contribution_and_merit.basis: invited professional perspective under defined scope

contribution_and_merit.name: Expert Contributor / Reviewer
contribution_and_merit.basis: documented subject contribution and applicable editorial/review governance

contribution_and_merit.name: Fellow / Faculty
contribution_and_merit.basis: separate Human Gate, criteria and institutional appointment process

partnership.name: Global Strategic Partner
partnership.basis: highest-scope formal partnership with separate Human Gate

separation_rules: Paid membership must not automatically confer academic merit, reviewer status, faculty/fellow status or institutional authority.
Contribution and merit statuses are earned through documented contribution and Human Gate criteria; they are not purchasable prestige.
Partnership status is contractual/institutional and must not be inferred from membership, networking, logo placement or a public conversation.
Open access to a public Zenodo record remains open regardless of WPA membership status.
No accreditation, government recognition, ranking advantage or third-party recognition is implied by any WPA Card tier.
monetization_rule: Monetize context, structure, verification, premium learning, tools, programmes, institutional delivery and confirmed partner value—not public knowledge merely because it is discoverable through WPA.
